primary.version: Unreal Tournament GOTY with OldUnreal 469 patch
primary.why: The original PC GOTY route is the archive baseline, and OldUnreal's current patches modernize stability, security, renderers, high-resolution UI, and OS support. Epic's official services were shut down, so community-supported installers/patches are now the practical preservation route.
primary.how_to_play: Use Unreal Tournament GOTY with the latest OldUnreal 469 patch. Record patch version, renderer, bonus packs/mods, bot settings, server browser/community master-server setup, and whether original disc behavior is being compared.

primary.version: Unreal Tournament 3 Black Edition, owned/offline build with Titan Pack
primary.why: Black Edition is the complete UT3 package with patch 2.0 and Titan Pack, but Epic delisted the game and shut down legacy online services. The archive route is an owned PC copy for campaign/bots/LAN/community play, with online-service shutdown state recorded.
primary.how_to_play: Use an owned PC Black Edition install. Record source/media, patch, Titan Pack, graphics settings, bots/campaign, LAN/community server route, master-server workaround if any, and whether PS3/Xbox 360 versions were compared.
